logs.description: Revision logs (CT_Revisions), one per header entry. logs[i] maps to headers.headers[i].rId.

enableFormatConditionsCalculation.description: Enable format conditions calculation (CT_SheetPr `@enableFormatConditionsCalculation`, XSD default true — only false is emitted)

outlineSummaryRight.description: Outline summary columns right of detail (CT_OutlinePr `@summaryRight`)

published.description: Published to server (CT_SheetPr `@published`, XSD default true — only false is emitted)

password.description: Plain-text password — legacy Excel hash is computed automatically on stringify. Authoring-only: not carried back by parse (the source stores a hash; re-hashing it would corrupt it). Use the algorithmName quadruplet below for round-trip.

sheet.description: Set true to enable sheet protection (required for protection flags to take effect)

spinCount.description: Modern encryption: spin count for hash iteration

topLeftCell.description: Top-left visible cell (CT_SheetView `@topLeftCell`); round-trip only meaningful when scrolled

zoomScalePageLayoutView.description: Zoom scale for page layout view (CT_SheetView `@zoomScalePageLayoutView`)

zoomScaleSheetLayoutView.description: Zoom scale for sheet layout view (CT_SheetView `@zoomScaleSheetLayoutView`)

SolidFillOptions.description:
Union type for all color options supported by solid fill.

Extends the original pattern with additional color types: RGB, scheme, HSL, system, and preset colors.

dxfId.description: Differential format id for cell/font-color sorts (CT_SortCondition `@dxfId`)

iconSet.description: Icon set for icon sorts (CT_SortCondition `@iconSet`, default "3Arrows")

ref.description: Cell reference for the sort column, e.g. "B1"

SortStateOptions.description: Sort state (CT_SortState) — sort conditions nested in their XSD container.

conditions.description: Sort conditions, one per sort level (CT_SortState `sortCondition` children)

SourceRectangleOptions.description:
Options for source rectangle cropping.

Each value is integer percent (10 = 10% crop from that edge of the image).

bottom.description: Bottom inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from bottom)

left.description: Left inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from left)

right.description: Right inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from right)

top.description: Top inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from top)

SphereCoords.description:
Sphere coordinates (CT_SphereCoords).

Used for camera and light rig rotation. All angles are in degrees.

StyleMatrixReferenceOptions.description:
Reference into the theme style matrix — a:lnRef / a:fillRef / a:effectRef.

Shared by theme object defaults (spDef style), shape styles, and table styles; declared once here so every consumer sees the same shape.

index.description: Index into the style matrix list (idx attribute).

SupplementalFontOptions.description: Supplemental font for a script range (CT_SupplementalFont).

SurfaceOptions.description: 3D wall/floor surface (CT_Surface thickness; spPr/pictureOptions not modeled here).

thickness.description: Surface thickness — plain number or percentage string ("N%").

lastClr.description: Last known RGB color value (optional fallback)

position.description: a:tab `@pos` — tab stop position in EMU.

calculatedColumnFormulaArray.description: Whether calculated column formula is array (CT_TableFormula `@array`)

totalsRowFormula.description: Totals row formula (CT_TableColumn/totalsRowFormula, used when totalsRowFunction is "custom")

totalsRowFormulaArray.description: Whether totals row formula is array (CT_TableFormula `@array`)

totalsRowLabel.description: Totals row label (used when totalsRowFunction is "none" or "custom")

uniqueName.description: Unique column name for structured references (CT_TableColumn `@uniqueName`)

xmlColumnPr.description: XML mapping (CT_XmlColumnPr) — binds the column to an XML map

autoFilter.description: Auto-filter (ref shorthand or structured filter columns/sort state)

displayName.description: Display name (required by XSD, defaults to name if not set)

headerRowBorderDxfId.description: Header row border differential format index

id.description: Unique table id (1-based, must be unique across the workbook)

totalsRowBorderDxfId.description: Totals row border differential format index

totalsRowShown.description: Whether to show totals row (default: true when totalsRowCount > 0)

anchor.description: Convenience sugar — merged into  {@link  bodyProperties }  on stringify (explicit `bodyProperties` fields take precedence). Input-only: parse always emits the normalized `bodyProperties` form. Mirrors the `fill` descriptor's string-sugar convention.

paragraphs.description: Paragraph list; string entries expand to a one-run paragraph.

text.description: Single-paragraph shorthand; expands to one paragraph on stringify.
a:t — display text (often a placeholder such as "‹#›" or "1/27/13").

TextFont.description: A script typeface (CT_TextFont). A bare string is the typeface only; the full object carries panose/pitchFamily/charset for embedded font metrics.

TextFontOptions.description: Single font slot — a:latin / a:ea / a:cs / a:sym (CT_TextFont).

referenceId.description: Internal placeholder key ("{hlink:N}" → "N"); preserved across parse → stringify.

slide.description:
Internal slide target, 1-based slide number (mutually exclusive with url). Emitted as r:id → slideN.xml + action="ppaction://hlinksldjump".

PPTX only — slides exist in no other format. Formats without slides reject the field at generate time instead of silently dropping it.

url.description: External URL target (mutually exclusive with slide).

TextListStyleGroupOptions.description: A title/body/other group: an optional empty defPPr plus up to 9 levels.

levels.description: Levels 1-9; index 0 = lvl1pPr. `null` omits the level (JSON form of an undefined array slot — the position still pins the level number).

eastAsianLineBreak.description: East-Asian line breaking (default true in MS Office).

schemeColor.description: Solid fill as a theme color token (e.g. "tx1").

TileAlignment.description:
Tile alignment within the shape.

Specifies the anchor position of the first tile relative to the shape.

TileFlipMode.description:
Tile flip mode for tiling images.

Specifies whether the image is flipped along the x-axis, y-axis, both axes, or not at all when tiling.

TileOptions.description:
Options for tile fill mode.

Configures how an image is tiled (repeated) to fill a shape.

alignment.description: Alignment of the first tile within the shape

tx.description: Horizontal offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

ty.description: Vertical offset for the tile origin in EMUs (number) or UniversalMeasure.

TintEffectOptions.description:
Options for tint effect.

## XSD: CT_TintEffect ```xml <xsd:attribute name="hue" type="ST_PositiveFixedAngle" default="0"/> <xsd:attribute name="amt" type="ST_FixedPercentage" default="0%"/> ```

amount.description: Amount in percentage points (0 to 100). Default 0.

TrendlineLabelOptions.description: Trendline label formatting (CT_TrendlineLbl — all children optional).

numberFormat.description: Number format applied to the trendline label (c:numFmt formatCode).

UniversalMeasure.description: Measurement string: number followed by a unit (mm, cm, in, pt, pc, pi or px).

VariantValue.description: JS-level variant value carried by a vt:* element.

hPercent.description: Height percentage of the chart (XSD CT_HPercent).

tables.description: Selected tables (CT_Tables: string name, number index, null = all/missing)

rId.description: Relationship ID to the published item

WebTableSelection.description: One web-query table selection (CT_Tables choice: m/s/x).

calcChain.description: Calculation chain cells (xl/calcChain.xml) — parse-only; compiler rebuilds from formulas

cellStyleXfs.description: Named cell-style templates (CT_CellStyleXfs) — definitions referenced by cellStyles

chartsheets.description: Chart-only sheets (no cells, just a chart)

customProperties.description: Custom properties (docProps/custom.xml); omitted from the package when empty

definedNames.description: Defined names — named ranges, constants, formulas (CT_DefinedNames)

dxfs.description: Pre-defined differential formats for conditional formatting

identifier.description: Unique document identifier, round-tripped from dc:identifier.

modified.description: Last modified timestamp (W3CDTF), round-tripped from dcterms:modified.

oleSize.description: OLE embedded range (CT_OleSize) — workbook-level, after calcPr

passthroughRelationships.description: Relationships from rebuilt parts' source .rels that point at rawParts (e.g. workbook.xml → externalLink/pivotCache). Re-emitted verbatim — target unchanged (passthrough paths never move), fresh rId. Round-trip only.

pivotCaches.description: Pivot cache definitions — parse-only (CT-layer); compiler regenerates from sourceData

rawParts.description: Parts carried verbatim from the source that generate() does not rebuild (drawings, VML, external links, any unknown extension part). Collected wholesale by the core passthrough pipeline — everything the model did not absorb survives with bytes and content-type declaration intact. Parts the compiler happens to rebuild under the same path win over the passthrough copy (assembly order), so model-driven parts need no exclusion here.

sharedStrings.description: Shared string table (xl/sharedStrings.xml), in table order. Parse fills it so generate() can seed the write context from the source entries — cells referencing rich-text si values keep their structure and index instead of collapsing to flattened text. Fresh documents omit it and register strings from cell values as they stringify.

theme.description: Theme (xl/theme/theme1.xml) — structured round-trip; fresh default when omitted

version.description: Document version number, round-tripped from cp:version.

workbookPr.description: Workbook properties (CT_WorkbookPr) — includes defaultThemeVersion, which Excel requires when the package carries a theme (dropping it makes the file unopenable)

revisionsHashValue.description: Revisions modern encryption: base64-encoded hash value

revisionsSaltValue.description: Revisions modern encryption: base64-encoded salt value

workbookPassword.description: Plain-text password — legacy Excel hash computed automatically

WorksheetChartOptions.description: Chart anchored to a worksheet. `title` stays the chart title (c:title); the graphicFrame's cNvPr `@title` is too weak to justify a name clash, so only name/description/hidden flow through to the drawing's cNvPr.

autoTitleDeleted.description: Auto-generated title suppressed (c:autoTitleDeleted) — emitted only when set.

axes.description: Per-axis configuration. Omitted, the library emits sensible default axes derived from chart type; provided, each axis is serialized verbatim and parsed back, enabling full round-trip of gridlines/units/tick marks/etc.

axisIds.description: Axis references (c:axId sequence on the chart group) — round-trip. Normally derived from `axes`; kept when the source sequence differs (legacy Word writes a dangling `axId val="0"` for a missing third axis).

bandFormats.description: Surface chart color bands (c:bandFmts, after ser in surface charts).

bubbleScale.description: Bubble scale as percent of default size (c:bubbleScale).

categoryFormatCode.description: Category number format (c:numCache > c:formatCode, numeric categories).

categoryFormula.description: Category reference formula (c:cat > c:*Ref > c:f) — round-trip.

categoryLabels.description: Literal category labels, emitted as c:strLit (c:cat > c:strLit).

colorMappingOverride.description: Theme color mapping override (c:clrMapOvr, before c:chart).

customSplitPoints.description: ofPie custom split point indices (c:custSplit > c:secondPiePt, with splitType "cust").

dataLabels.description: Chart-group-level data labels (c:dLbls after the ser elements).

date1904.description: 1904 date system (c:date1904) — emitted only when the source had it.

description.description: XSD `@descr` — alt text for accessibility; emitted only when present.

extentCx.description: Anchor extent width in EMU (oneCell/absoluteAnchor ext, default 400000).

extentCy.description: Anchor extent height in EMU (oneCell/absoluteAnchor ext, default 300000).

firstSliceAngle.description: Pie/doughnut first slice angle in degrees (c:firstSliceAng).

gapWidth.description: Bar/column gap width as percent of width (c:gapWidth).

hidden.description: XSD `@hidden` (default false); emitted as "1" only when true.

holeSize.description: Pie/doughnut doughnut hole size as percent (c:holeSize).

lang.description: Chart UI language (c:lang, e.g. "en-US") — emitted only when set.

legendPosition.description: Legend position (c:legendPos, defaults to "r" when legend is shown).

markers.description: Show line-chart markers (c:marker CT_Boolean on c:lineChart, 2D only). Emitted only when set.

name.description: XSD `@name` (required in XML); API-optional, the descriptor synthesizes a fallback.

numericCategories.description: Categories are numeric (c:cat carries c:numRef/c:numCache instead of c:strRef/c:strCache). Numeric categories render on a value-formatted axis; parse sets this when the source used numRef.

ofPieType.description: ofPie variant: pie-of-pie or bar-of-pie (c:ofPieType, default "pie").

pivotFormats.description: Pivot chart per-series formats (c:pivotFmts, after autoTitleDeleted).

pivotSource.description: Pivot chart source (c:pivotSource, after clrMapOvr, before protection).

plotVisOnly.description: Plot visible cells only (c:plotVisOnly, defaults to true when omitted).

roundedCorners.description: Rounded chart-area corners (c:roundedCorners) — emitted only when set.

secondPieSize.description: ofPie second-pie size — number (5–200) or percent string (c:secondPieSize).

shape.description: 3D bar column shape (chart-group-level c:shape on c:bar3DChart).

shapeProperties.description: Chart-area shape properties (c:spPr after c:chart) — round-trip.

showDataLabelsOverMax.description: Show data labels over the chart maximum (c:showDLblsOverMax).

splitPosition.description: ofPie split position (c:splitPos, used with splitType pos/val).

title.description: Chart title (c:title). An empty string round-trips a title placeholder that carries no text (bare `<c:title/>`, the legacy-Word auto-title form).

toCol.description: To cell column (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to col + 1.

toColOffset.description: To cell column offset in EMU.

toRow.description: To cell row (1-based) for twoCellAnchor. Defaults to row + 1.

toRowOffset.description: To cell row offset in EMU.

upDownBarsGapWidth.description: Gap width inside the up/down bars container (c:upDownBars > c:gapWidth).

userShapes.description: User-drawn shapes relationship id (c:userShapes r:id, after printSettings).

varyColors.description: Vary data-point colors (chart-group-level c:varyColors). Emitted only when set — the corpus is mixed and fresh output stays bare.

dimension.description: Cell range dimension (CT_Dimension ref); auto-computed when omitted

groups.description: Anchored groups (xdr:grpSp): group transform + nested children.

ignoredErrors.description: Ignored errors — suppress specific Excel error checks for cell ranges

legacyDrawingHF.description: Legacy drawing for header/footer r:id (CT_LegacyDrawingHF). Round-trip only: the referenced VML part is not re-emitted by the compiler.

protectedRanges.description: Named protected ranges within this sheet

selection.description: Selections in sheet view (CT_Selection — one per pane, max 4)

shapes.description: Anchored shapes (xdr:sp): geometry + optional text body.

singleXmlCells.description: Single-cell XML tables on this sheet (xl/tables/tableSingleCellsN.xml)

sortState.description: Sheet-level sort state (CT_Worksheet `sortState` — sorting without a filter)

XYAdjustHandle.description:
XY adjust handle (CT_XYAdjustHandle).

Allows the user to drag a handle in X/Y directions.

XmlCellPropertiesOptions.description: Cell properties of a single-cell XML table (CT_XmlCellPr).

XmlColumnPrOptions.description: XML column properties (CT_XmlColumnPr — table column bound to an XML map).

mapId.description: XML map id (required, indexes xl/xmlMaps.xml Map entries)
